      Generate a full ad
      
            backend: browser (Flow)
          
      
          
      
            Write the script, hit generate, and the whole ad is built from scratch:
            one consistent persona image, one Veo clip per line (or per ~8s segment),
            captions burned in, then stitched together. Pick a body video to
            reuse an existing body and just generate a fresh hook in front of it
            (e.g. reuse the nurse-debt body but target seniors). Uses the browser
            (Flow) backend — make sure you're logged in via npm run login.

      Static image ads
      
            model: gpt-image-2
          
      
          
      
            Upload winning static ads. Each one is studied with vision (vertical,
            angle, on-image copy, why it converts), then fresh variations are
            generated — keeping what works but rewriting the headline/subhead for
            your angle. Leave vertical/angle blank to use what the study infers.
            Needs OPENAI_API_KEY.

        Ad-library research
        
            
          
        
          
        
            Whitelist the Meta Pages you want to watch. The crawler reads their
            active ads from the Facebook Ad Library, infers each ad's vertical,
            and ranks the ones that look like they're scaling (running a long time
            with many active copies). Nothing is generated until you approve a
            suggestion below. You must be logged into Facebook once via
            npm run login.
